# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## 1. Number Placement Puzzles
*(Fill cells with numbers according to constraints)*
- Sudoku
- Fillomino
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Hebi

## 2. Loop Drawing Puzzles
*(Draw a single continuous closed loop)*
- Masyu
- Slitherlink
- Dotchi-Loop
- Nagareru
- Moon-or-Sun
- Mid-loop
- Suraromu
- Yajilin

## 3. Cell Shading / Painting Puzzles
*(Colour or blacken cells according to rules)*
- Hitori
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Usowan
- Tilepaint
- Choco Banana
- Sto-stone
- Norinori
- Nuritwin
- LITS

## 4. Region / Area Division Puzzles
*(Partition the grid into defined regions or blocks)*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Sashigane
- Double Choco
- Chained Block
- Shakashaka

## 5. Path & Connection Puzzles
*(Connect elements or trace paths through the grid)*
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Pencils
- Evolomino
- Nurimeizu

## 6. Object Placement Puzzles
*(Place specific objects into the grid)*
- Akari
- Juosan
- Nurimisaki

## 7. Movement & Transformation Puzzles
*(Move or evolve elements within the grid)*
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe
- Ripple Effect → *(moved above)*
- Norinori → *(moved above)*
